title: Halite III winning bot
mechanism: Dijkstra travel/mining efficiency, collision-risk thresholds, spawn/dropoff ROI, previous-version and behavior-variant regression opponents.
kaggriculture_applicability: Use bounded route cost, explicit opportunity cost and opponent-risk scenarios in task assignment/economic gates.
non_applicability: Do not copy source because repository license is undeclared; Halite mining geometry and one-ship actions are not Kaggriculture rules.
minimum_delta: Add one observable-state opportunity-cost term or one bounded assignment stage, never both in one candidate.
falsifier: Fresh both-seat paired delta fails, protected actions differ, runtime gate fails, or benefit appears only versus one lineage.

title: Halite III 4th-place bot

minimum_delta: Rare-contention, top-k rectangular assignment with formal priority dominance and exact fallback.
falsifier: No actual formal-vs-assignment decision changes, negative per-opponent money/match delta, stranded higher-priority tasks, or p95 above gate.

falsifier: Archetype gate is unstable, identity-correlated, or loses on any protected lane.
